title: kanban ledger log.jsonl line (format 3)
description: One line of kanban/log.jsonl, format version 3: one JSON object per line, appended by kanban only. A line has one of four shapes, told apart by its keys: kanban config set (config), a routine's firing (routine), kanban migrate (migrate), else an issue's change (id and change). Readers skip a line they can't read. Lines written before ids had four digits keep the short id (A-5), and config lines from before 2026-11-06 say coordinator.

by.description: terminal:<HC_TERMINAL_ID> when run in a herdr-core terminal (the dispatcher is terminal:dispatcher), else the user name, else unknown.

name.description: One plain name (an id or a routine's name): no /, \ or :, and not . or ...

issueLine.description: A change to one issue: kanban add, start, set, review, done, report and the questions.

change.description: The keys that changed, with their new value (null for a removed key); kanban set writes any key so. Besides issue.yaml keys: add for a new issue, report for kanban report, question for a question's status, forced for the questions kanban done or review --force (or --past, only those it names) moved past, freedBy for an issue moved out of queued by kanban done.

report.description: kanban report wrote report.md, or appended to it (--append).

question.description: The number of the question whose status changed (with status).

status.description: The issue's new status (a column, null when removed), or with question the question's new status.

forced.description: The numbers of the questions not received that --force moved past (with status).

freedBy.description: The id of the issue whose kanban done moved this one out of queued (with status).

config.description: The config.yaml keys that changed, with their new value (null for a removed key).

routineLine.description: A routine's firing: an issue added (fired) or none (skipped). No id.

fired.description: The id of the issue it added.

skipped.description: Why it added none: paused, or open of its issues are not done.

migrateLine.description: kanban migrate moved the ledger from .flightdeck. No id.

migrate.description: Where from, and the ids it renamed.
